scope: Trusted user-invoked external draft editor, native terminal handoff and private bounded import; no model-facing terminal capability or model-performance claim

source_seal.algorithm: Same sorted raw/LF UTF-8 JSON file-hash map selection as background-logs-20261028.json; docs/reports and virtual environments excluded

unit_snapshot.delta_reason: Manual native-terminal observer now waits for the actual editor busy/return cycle and requires final phase=done, rather than treating a closed approval modal or exit code alone as completion.

contracts.activation: trusted user/profile editor.command; empty disables; no EDITOR/VISUAL inference or model tool
contracts.placeholder: at most one standalone {file}; otherwise append private path; no implicit shell
contracts.authorization: fresh literal True; readonly and disabled run block; draft/config/conversation/cancellation rechecked
contracts.privacy: random private non-repository directory; known credentials rejected in argv/input/result; protected Windows ACL or POSIX 0700/0600 and child umask 0077
contracts.atomic_save: Windows seals only the exact temporary single-link bounded regular file by handle before strict private read; never weakens the shared reader
contracts.import: exit 0, complete UTF-8, CRLF/CR to LF, no terminal controls, stable fd-based identity before/after read, single link, no reparse or FIFO
contracts.cleanup: known draft.md plus empty generated directory only; unknown editor side files left private and reported, never recursively removed
contracts.processes: owned Windows Job Object from creation; POSIX foreground group handoff/restore and owned group cleanup
contracts.composer: expand actual pastes; preserve whitespace, literal slash text, undo/redo; retain only selected untouched mention spans; no attachment authority from typed labels
contracts.dispatch: return to composer; actual Enter required; original request budget and failed-send draft retention unchanged
contracts.terminal_output: user-owned terminal while suspended, not tool-output capture; returned draft and model request remain bounded
contracts.cache_and_acceptance: invalidate read versions/syntax cache and UI acceptance; no model/history branch or automatic continuation

coverage.tui_headless: 80x24, suspension capability enabled only in fixtures; real native terminal proven separately
coverage.native_input: declared fixture-confirm plus a separate Enter after report phase draft_restored; no blind input or human/model equivalence claim

findings: Windows path stat and CRT fstat identity representations differed; use fd-based comparisons for both reopened handles.
UI runner called cancellation logic requiring a Textual worker; use shared tool cancellation from the UI.

Atomic editor replacement inherited an unprotected Windows ACL; seal the owned independent temporary file to current-user owner/protected DACL after no-link/size checks, then use the unchanged strict reader.
Fixtures initially mixed sync/async context managers and embedded 10000 bytes in an 8 KiB command; fix fixture construction without increasing budgets.

An early terminal observer could run between modal close and approval callback, and one delayed manual-input probe timed out. Incomplete probes are not passes; final observer requires the actual run/return cycle and final done report, with gated fixture input.

remote_ci: pending; no Actions before 2026-11-01 Asia/Singapore; recheck account restriction and prior required gate before resuming
limits: Trusted editor/GUI/plugins have current-user system/network access; not an OS sandbox, model PTY or key-injection API.

Uncaptured user terminal output is distinct from bounded model tool output. GUI brokers or programs that return before file close cannot guarantee completion or cleanup of existing external instances.
Local Windows/WSL and a controlled editor do not prove all installed editor/plugin combinations, macOS, the full Python matrix, remote native CI or real coding gains.
